lines.text: Many learners say: Actually, it is raining now.
Better: Right now, it is raining.
Actually means in fact, not now.
Right now! It is raining right now.

data.why: Actually means in fact, not now.

native.tip: „Actually“ heißt „eigentlich“. Für „aktuell“ oder „gerade“ sagst du „right now“.

en.hook: Do you want to say “gerade jetzt”?
en.tip: “Actually” means “eigentlich”. For “aktuell” or “gerade” you say “right now”.
en.caption: “Actually” means eigentlich in German, not aktuell. Wrong: “Actually, it is raining now.” Right: “Right now, it is raining.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
